title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning and extend audit logging for key residency
author: Sofia Patel
description: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning at policy evaluation time and extend audit logging to include explicit key residency decisions. Motivation: customers in regulated regions have been requesting stronger guarantees that KMS usage respects configured region residency policies. Previously we emitted only high-level audit events when keys were created/used; this PR adds explicit audit records for region-pin evaluations and rejects requests that violate enforced residency policies. Key components: 1) policy engine change to consult kms:region when evaluating rbac_v2 policies, 2) new audit events (kms.region_evaluation.start|result) emitted to the centralized audit pipeline, 3) admin-config flag (rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning) to toggle enforcement during rollout, 4) migration script to backfill residency annotations for existing keys in registry, 5) test-suite additions (unit + integration + e2e) and console docs updates. The description below covers implementation notes, migration plan, and testing summary.

merge_commit_message: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning and extend audit logging\n\nIncludes policy evaluator changes, audit events, migration for existing keys, tests, and docs.
release_notes: Enforcement of KMS region pinning behind feature flag: rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning=false by default. When enabled, requests that violate KMS key residency policies will be rejected and will emit explicit audit events (kms.region_evaluation.start/result) for compliance trails. Includes migration tool to annotate existing keys for residency. Admins should review the migration output before enabling enforcement.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for policy evaluator and audit serializer. Integration tests run in staging with a small key set and validated rejection paths. e2e scenario covers a multi-tenant workspace with mixed key residencies; e2e was flaky once due to test clock timing, fixed by using monotonic timers. Manual verification: staging cluster logs show new audit events exported to the audit pipeline and dashboard tiles updated.
migration_instructions: Run tools/migrations/2024-11-backfill-key-residency.py against the key registry (dry-run flag available). Validate produced annotations in admin console. After backfill, flip rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning to true in a controlled rollout (start with a single region) and monitor audit dashboard for violations.
risk_and_rollout: Low risk if feature flag stays off. Rollout plan: enable enforcement in a single non-production region for 48 hours, validate zero violations for expected workloads, then enable gradually across tenants. In case of unexpected failures, disable the feature flag and investigate with the provided migration logs. Backfill script is idempotent.
additional_notes: This PR does not change KMS transport or key material handling; it only changes policy decision logic and audit emission. We coordinated with the infra SREs to ensure audit pipeline capacity can handle added events.
